内容提要
这本连环画是根据古典神话小说《西游记》第四十——
四十二回编绘的。描述唐僧师徒四人在取经途中，路过号
山枯松涧，遇红孩妖拦截，并将唐僧摄入火云洞中。孙悟
空英勇机智斗妖魔，最后在南海观音菩萨的帮助下，降伏
了红孩妖，救出师父。师徒四人又继续向西天行进。

1 话说唐僧师徒四人离了乌鸡国，夜住晓行，这天走
到一座高山前。这山真是摩天碍日。唐僧在马上心惊，急
兜住缰绳，叫徒弟们防备妖怪作乱。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
This illustrated storybook is adapted from chapters forty to forty-two of the classical mythological novel 'Journey to the West'. It describes how the four disciples of Tang Sanzang, during their journey to obtain scriptures, passed through Hao Mountain's Ku Song Gorge, were intercepted by the Red Boy demon, who captured Tang Sanzang in the Fire Cloud Cave. Sun Wukong bravely and cleverly fought the demon, and finally, with the help of the Bodhisattva Guanyin from the South Sea, subdued the Red Boy demon and rescued his master. The four disciples then continued their journey westward.

1 Once upon a time, the four disciples of Tang Sanzang left Wujigu Kingdom, traveling at night and resting in the morning. On this day, they arrived at the foot of a high mountain. The mountain was truly towering and blocking the sun. Tang Sanzang, alarmed while riding his horse, quickly pulled the reins and called out to his disciples to be on guard against demons causing trouble.
summary_zh: 本页包含《西游记》连环画《火云洞》的内容提要，概述了唐僧师徒遇红孩妖、孙悟空降伏妖怪并救出师父的故事情节；下方插图及文字描述了师徒四人离开乌鸡国后，行至高山前，唐僧因山势险峻而心惊，提醒徒弟们防备妖怪。

2 孙悟空叫师父放心，说自有老孙保护。长老宽怀，加鞭策马，行到山前。只见山凹里升起一朵红云，直冲到空中，结聚了一团火气。
3 悟空大惊，急忙把唐僧推下马来，叫道：‘师父、师弟们，不要走，妖怪来了！’慌得八戒急掣钉钯，沙僧忙抢宝杖，把唐僧围护在当中。
page_text_en:
2 Sun Wukong told his master to be at ease, saying that he, Old Sun, would protect him. The elder, reassured, urged his horse forward and arrived at the foot of the mountain. He saw a red cloud rising from a mountain hollow, shooting straight into the sky and gathering into a mass of fire.
3 Wukong was greatly alarmed and quickly pushed Tang Sanzang off his horse, shouting, 'Master, disciples, don't move—demons are here!' In panic, Zhu Bajie hastily drew his rake, and Sha Wujing quickly grabbed his staff, surrounding Tang Sanzang to protect him.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒行至山前，孙悟空见山凹升起红云并聚成火气，大惊之下推下唐僧，高呼妖怪来了，八戒和沙僧立即持武器围护师父。

4 原来那红光真是个妖怪。他听说吃了唐僧肉，可以长生不老，便天天在山里等候，今日终于等得唐僧到了。他在那半空里观看，见三个徒弟把唐僧围护着，不好下手。
5 妖怪心想：不知哪个有眼力的，已经识破我了。他又一转念：力取不如智取。立即按下云头，变作七岁顽童，用麻绳捆了手脚，吊在松树上，高叫：‘救人，救人！’
page_text_en:
4 The red light was indeed a demon. He had heard that eating Tang Sanzang's flesh could grant immortality, so he waited in the mountains every day. Today, he finally saw Tang Sanzang arrive. From the sky, he watched and saw the three disciples protecting Tang Sanzang, making it difficult for him to act.
5 The demon thought: I don't know which one of them has sharp eyes and has already seen through me. He then changed his mind: force is not as good as strategy. He immediately descended from the clouds, transformed into a seven-year-old child, tied his hands and feet with hemp rope, hung from a pine tree, and shouted: 'Help me, help me!'
summary_zh: 本页揭示了红光实为妖怪，他为吃唐僧肉而等待多时，见唐僧被徒弟们保护，无法直接下手，便转而化作被绑的孩童，高呼救命，企图用计谋诱骗唐僧师徒。

6 悟空看见红云忽然散尽，火气全无，便叫师父上马走路。唐僧说既是有妖怪，怎么又敢走路？悟空说这妖怪可能是过路的，已经走了。唐僧听了，似信非信，只好上马赶路。
7 刚走不远，只听得“救人、救人”的叫声。唐僧大惊，忙问悟空。悟空叫他只管走路，少管闲事！唐僧只好策马又走。可是那一阵阵的呼救声还在耳边回响。
page_text_en:
6 Wukong saw the red clouds suddenly dissipate and the fire vanish, so he called for his master to mount the horse and continue walking. Tang Sanzang said, 'If there's a demon, how can we dare to walk?' Wukong replied, 'This demon might have just passed by and is gone now.' Tang Sanzang, half-believing and half-doubting, could only mount the horse and continue on the road.
7 Not far ahead, they heard cries of 'Help! Help!' Tang Sanzang was greatly alarmed and hurriedly asked Wukong. Wukong told him to just keep walking and mind his own business! Tang Sanzang could only urge the horse forward again. But those cries for help still echoed in his ears.
summary_zh: 孙悟空发现红云和火气消失后，劝唐僧上马赶路，唐僧半信半疑；师徒刚走不远，便听到呼救声，唐僧惊问，孙悟空却让他不要管闲事，继续赶路，但呼救声仍在耳边回响。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

8 悟空心中暗想：这泼怪不知在哪里，只管叫啊叫的，等老孙给他一点手段看看。于是悟空让唐僧一行人先走几步，念个咒语，使个移山缩地法，把金箍棒往后一指，就把那怪物撇在山后。
9 再说那妖精在山坡里连连叫喊，不见有人来救，心中思量：“这倒奇了！明明唐僧离此不远，却怎么半日不见到来？”他抖一抖身躯，脱了绳索，又纵红云，到空中察看。
page_text_en:
8 Wukong thought to himself: This rascal doesn't know where he is, just shouting and shouting. Let me show him a little trick. So Wukong told Tang Sanzang and the others to walk a few steps ahead, chanted a spell, used the mountain-moving and earth-shrinking technique, pointed his golden staff backward, and left the monster behind the mountain.
9 Meanwhile, the demon kept shouting on the hillside, but no one came to rescue him. He thought to himself: "How strange! Tang Sanzang is clearly not far away, yet why hasn't he arrived after half a day?" He shook his body, broke free from the ropes, rode the red cloud again, and went up into the sky to look around.
summary_zh: 孙悟空用移山缩地法将妖怪甩在山后，妖怪不见唐僧前来救援，便脱绳索驾云升空查看。

10 悟空仰面看见红云，又把唐僧拽下马来。八戒、沙僧也急忙上前围护。
11 那妖精见不得下手，心想：‘要把那个有眼力的弄倒了，才能捉得唐僧，不然仍是枉费心机。’于是，这妖怪又按下云头，到前面去等候。
page_text_en:
10 Wukong looked up and saw red clouds, then pulled Tang僧 off his horse. Bajie and Sha僧 hurried forward to protect him.
11 The demon, unable to act, thought: 'I must knock out that sharp-eyed one before I can capture Tang僧; otherwise, all my efforts will be wasted.' So, the demon descended from the clouds and went ahead to wait.
summary_zh: 孙悟空再次发现红云，将唐僧拽下马，八戒和沙僧上前保护；妖怪因无法得手，决定先除掉孙悟空，于是飞到前方等候。

12 孙悟空抬头再看，只见红云又散了，就再请师父上马前行。唐僧不住地埋怨悟空三番两次地把他推下马来，又不见妖怪，狠狠地要念紧箍咒。沙僧上前苦苦相劝，才又上马西行。
13 又走不远，只听得有人喊叫：‘师父，救人啊！’唐僧抬头看时，见是个小孩，赤条条地吊在树上，便骂悟空没有半点慈悲之心，见小孩不救。
page_text_en:
12 Sun Wukong looked up again and saw the red clouds had dispersed, so he asked his master to remount the horse and continue forward. Tang Sanzang kept complaining that Wukong had pushed him off the horse again and again, yet no monster was seen, and he angrily threatened to chant the Tightening咒. Sha Wujing stepped forward to plead with him, and only then did Tang Sanzang remount the horse and continue westward.
13 Not far ahead, they heard someone shouting: 'Master, save me!' Tang Sanzang looked up and saw a child, naked, hanging from a tree. He scolded Wukong for having no compassion at all, for not saving the child.
summary_zh: 孙悟空发现红云散去后请唐僧上马前行，唐僧因多次被推下马而埋怨并欲念紧箍咒，沙僧劝解后才继续西行；不久后，师徒听到呼救声，见一赤身小孩吊在树上，唐僧责骂孙悟空见死不救。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'

14 悟空见师父怪他，怕念紧箍咒，便低着头，不敢回言，眼睁睁地看着师父下马，走到树下。
15 唐僧走上前问道：‘你是哪家孩儿？怎会吊在这里？’那妖魔装模作样，眼中噙泪，一边哭，一边信口编造，说他家遭匪徒抢劫，他被吊在这里。唐僧信以为真，便叫八戒把他放了下来。
page_text_en:
14 Wukong saw his master scolding him, afraid of the Tightening咒, lowered his head, dared not reply, and stared helplessly as his master dismounted and walked under the tree.
15 Tang Sanzang walked forward and asked: 'Which family are you from? How did you end up hanging here?' The demon pretended, tears in his eyes, crying while making up a story, saying his family had been robbed by bandits and he had been hung here. Tang Sanzang believed it and ordered Bajie to let him down.
summary_zh: 孙悟空因多次推下唐僧而被责怪，低头不敢言语；唐僧走近被吊在树上的妖怪，听其哭诉家遭劫掠，信以为真，命猪八戒将其放了下来。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

16 唐僧心慈，叫那怪上马，要送他回家，他却推说吊得腰酸腿疼，骑不得马，唐僧便叫悟空背他。那怪心中暗自欢喜。悟空心想：‘你这个泼怪，今日该死了，怎敢在老孙面前捣鬼？我摔死你！’于是背上他就走。
17 那怪物却早知觉了，他往四下里吸了四口气，吹在悟空背上，悟空便觉得重有千斤，笑道：‘我儿啊，你使重身法压我哩。’那怪听说，恐怕悟空伤他，就使个分身法，真身急忙飞到空中。
page_text_en:
16 Tang僧 was kind-hearted and told the monster to get on the horse to take him home. The monster, however, claimed he was too sore from being hung and couldn't ride. Tang僧 then told Wukong to carry him. The monster secretly rejoiced. Wukong thought: 'You rascal, you're doomed today! How dare you trick me in front of Old Sun? I'll throw you down!' So he picked him up and walked off.
17 The monster, however, had already realized what was happening. He sucked in four breaths from all around and blew them onto Wukong's back. Wukong immediately felt as heavy as a thousand catties and laughed: 'My child, you're using the heavy-body technique to press me down!' Hearing this, the monster, fearing Wukong might hurt him, used his body-splitting technique and quickly flew into the air with his true form.
summary_zh: 唐僧让妖怪上马，妖怪推说腰酸腿疼，唐僧便让孙悟空背他。孙悟空背起妖怪后，妖怪暗中使用重身法使孙悟空感到沉重，孙悟空识破后，妖怪便用分身法逃走。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

18 悟空越驮越重，不禁发了怒，抓过背上的妖精，往石头上“叭啦”一摔，将假身摔得像个肉饼一般，还恐怕妖精变化，索性将他的四肢扯碎，丢在路旁。
19 那妖怪见此计又被悟空看破，心头火起，就在半空中卷起一阵旋风，只刮得唐僧伏在马上，八戒、沙僧不敢抬头。那怪趁着风势将唐僧摄走了。
page_text_en:
18 Wukong felt heavier and heavier as he carried the demon, and couldn't help getting angry. He grabbed the demon from his back, slammed him onto a rock with a 'plop', flattening the fake body like a meat pie. Still fearing the demon might transform, he tore its limbs to pieces and threw them aside.
19 The demon, seeing his trick exposed again by Wukong, became furious. He conjured a whirlwind in mid-air, blowing the monk down onto his horse, while Bajie and Sha僧 dared not lift their heads. The demon then seized the opportunity to snatch the monk away in the wind.
summary_zh: 孙悟空识破妖怪的重身法后，将其摔碎丢弃；妖怪恼羞成怒，卷起旋风将唐僧掳走，八戒和沙僧惊恐不敢抬头。

20 孙大圣情知是怪物弄风，急纵步赶来，已经晚了。只见白龙马战兢兢地嘶鸣，行李丢在路上，八戒、沙僧躲在一旁，只不见了师父。
21 悟空抱怨道：‘我原认得那树上吊着的孩子是个妖精，师父不识，还要叫我背他；师父就不听我的话，真叫人心灰意懒！’沙僧听了，劝悟空说：‘还是救师父要紧。’
page_text_en:
20 Sun Wukong realized it was a monster conjuring wind, and hurried over, but it was too late. He saw the White Dragon Horse trembling and neighing, luggage scattered on the road, and Pigsy and Sandy hiding nearby, but the Master was nowhere to be seen.
21 Wukong complained: 'I knew that child hanging from the tree was a demon. The Master didn't recognize it, and still asked me to carry him; the Master wouldn't listen to me, which truly makes me feel disheartened!' Sandy, upon hearing this, advised Wukong: 'Saving the Master is the most urgent matter.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空赶到时，唐僧已被妖怪掳走，白龙马惊鸣，行李散落，八戒和沙僧躲在一旁。悟空抱怨师父不听劝，沙僧劝他应优先救师父。

22 悟空心急，将身一纵，跳上山顶，大喝一声，便唤来了众山神、土地。
23 孙悟空问清了此山叫号山，山中有座火云洞，洞中有个红孩儿妖，号称“圣婴大王”，是牛魔王的儿子。悟空辞别众神，笑呵呵地走回来，对八戒、沙僧道：‘这妖怪还与我老孙沾亲哩！’
page_text_en:
22 Wukong, anxious, leapt up to the mountain top, shouted loudly, and summoned the mountain gods and land spirits.
23 Sun Wukong learned that this mountain was called Hao Mountain, with a Fire Cloud Cave inside. In the cave lived a demon child, known as 'Saint Infant King', the son of Bull Demon King. Wukong bid farewell to the gods, walked back laughing, and said to Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing: 'This demon is actually related to me!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空为救唐僧，跳上山顶召唤山神土地，得知妖怪是牛魔王之子红孩儿后，笑着对八戒和沙僧说妖怪与自己有亲缘关系。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

24 八戒笑道：‘妖精怎么会和你有亲？’悟空说他在花果山时，曾和牛魔王结拜兄弟，这妖怪是牛魔王的儿子，论起辈来，我还是这妖怪的老叔哩。八戒、沙僧听了哈哈大笑，三个人便去寻找师父。
25 行了百十里，忽见一座松林，林中有一条曲涧，涧上有一条石板桥，通向一个洞口。悟空对八戒、沙僧道：‘你们看，那边石崖下的洞口，想是妖精的住处吧！’
page_text_en:
24 Pigsy laughed, "How can a demon be related to you?" Wukong said that when he was on Flower-Fruit Mountain, he had sworn brotherhood with Bull Demon King. This demon is Bull Demon King's son; by lineage, I am still his uncle. Pigsy and Sandy laughed heartily upon hearing this, and the three set off to search for their master.
25 After traveling a hundred or so li, they suddenly saw a pine forest. Inside the forest was a winding stream, with a stone bridge over it leading to a cave entrance. Wukong said to Pigsy and Sandy, "Look, that cave entrance under the cliff over there—must be the demon's lair!"
summary_zh: 孙悟空向八戒和沙僧解释自己与妖怪红孩儿有亲戚关系，三人一同前往寻找被掳走的唐僧；途中发现一处松林中的洞穴，悟空判断那是妖怪的住处。

source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

26 沙僧在树林里看管行李、马匹。悟空和八戒两人跳过枯松涧，来到石洞前，只见一群小妖正在洞前抢枪舞剑、打闹玩耍。
27 悟空八戒厉声高叫，吓得众小妖纷纷往洞中逃去，最后两个小妖急忙掩上洞门。
page_text_en:
26 Sha Wujing watches over the luggage and horses in the forest. Wukong and BaJie jump across the dried-up pine ravine and arrive at the stone cave, where they see a group of small demons playing and fighting with spears and swords.
27 Wukong and BaJie shout loudly, scaring the small demons, who rush into the cave. The last two small demons hastily close the cave door.
summary_zh: 孙悟空和猪八戒来到妖怪洞穴前，发现小妖们正在玩耍，便厉声喝叫，吓得小妖们纷纷逃入洞中并关上洞门。

28 再说那红孩妖把三藏拿到洞中，正在准备蒸吃，听到小妖来报，便抄起丈八火尖枪，走出洞来。
29 悟空见红孩妖出来，便把他和牛魔王结拜弟兄的事说了一遍，用好言相劝，叫他把师父交出来。红孩妖哪里肯信，举起火尖枪就刺，悟空不慌不忙，抡棒相迎。
page_text_en:
28 Then, the Red Boy demon had taken Master Sanzang to his cave and was preparing to steam him for food. Upon hearing a report from a minor demon, he grabbed his eight-foot fire-tipped spear and stepped out of the cave.
29 When Wukong saw the Red Boy demon come out, he told him about their sworn brotherhood with the Bull Demon King, trying to reason with him and asking him to return his master. The Red Boy demon, however, refused to believe him, raised his fire-tipped spear to strike, and Wukong calmly swung his staff to meet him.
summary_zh: 红孩儿将唐僧掳至洞中准备蒸食，得知孙悟空等人到来后持枪出洞；孙悟空试图以与牛魔王的结拜关系劝说红孩儿放人，但红孩儿不信，双方随即拔剑相向，展开对峙。

30 他两个各显神通，跳在云端里厮杀，战有二十回合，不分胜败。八戒抖擞精神，举着九齿钯，跳到空中，照准妖精劈头就筑。红孩妖招架不住，败下阵来。
31 红孩妖逃到洞口，猛转身，念动咒语，顿时口喷火，鼻冒烟，熊熊烈火直扑悟空、八戒。八戒慌忙逃走。
page_text_en:
30 The two of them displayed their supernatural powers, fighting fiercely in the clouds for twenty rounds, neither gaining the upper hand. Eight-Precepts rallied his spirit, raised his nine-toothed rake, leapt into the air, and swung down at the demon's head. The Red Boy demon couldn't block the attack and retreated in defeat.
31 The Red Boy demon fled to the cave entrance, turned sharply, chanted a spell, and instantly breathed fire and smoke from his mouth and nose. A fierce blaze surged toward Wukong and Eight-Precepts. Eight-Precepts hurriedly fled.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与红孩儿在云端激战二十回合不分胜负，猪八戒加入战斗后，红孩儿不敌败退；红孩儿逃至洞口后喷出烈火，猪八戒慌忙逃走。

32 悟空捏着避火诀冲入火中，寻找妖怪。红孩妖又吐上几口，那火比以前更猛。悟空在烟火中看不清去洞门的路，也找不见妖怪，只得退出火外。
33 红孩妖见悟空走了，便收了妖火，率领群妖，回转洞内，自以为得胜，叫群妖排筵奏乐，开怀畅饮。
page_text_en:
32 Wukong, holding the fire-avoiding spell, rushed into the flames to search for the demon. Honghaiya spat out a few more mouthfuls, and the fire became even fiercer. Wukong couldn't see the path to the cave entrance through the smoke and flames, nor could he find the demon, so he had to retreat outside the fire.
33 Honghaiya, seeing Wukong had left, retracted his demonic fire, led his followers back into the cave, felt he had won, and ordered his demons to set up a feast, play music, and drink heartily.
summary_zh: 孙悟空冲入红孩儿喷出的烈火中寻找妖怪，但因火势太猛、烟雾弥漫而无法找到路径和妖怪，只得退出；红孩儿见悟空退走，便收起妖火，带领群妖返回洞内，自以为获胜，设宴奏乐庆祝。

34 悟空回到松林，与八戒、沙僧商议如何破得妖火，救出师父。沙僧说，必须以水克火。悟空连称“好办法！好办法！”他叫八戒、沙僧在松林等候，自己去找龙王来帮忙。
35 悟空纵上云头，不一会儿到了东海，使个逼水法，分开波浪，直到龙宫前。老龙王闻讯，急忙率领龙子、龙孙、虾兵蟹将，一齐出门迎接。
page_text_en:
34 Wukong returned to the pine forest and discussed with Bajie and Sha僧 how to defeat the demon's fire and rescue their master. Sha僧 said, 'We must use water to overcome fire.' Wukong exclaimed, 'Good idea! Good idea!' He told Bajie and Sha僧 to wait in the pine forest while he went to find the Dragon King for help.
35 Wukong leaped onto the clouds and soon arrived at the Eastern Sea. He used the water-dividing technique to part the waves and reached the Dragon Palace. Upon hearing the news, the Old Dragon King hurriedly led his dragon sons, dragon grandsons, shrimp soldiers, and crab generals out to greet him.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与八戒、沙僧商议破除妖火之法，决定用水克火，并前往东海请龙王帮忙；他抵达龙宫，龙王率众迎接。

36 悟空说明来意，龙王不敢怠慢，当下便亲自击鼓撞钟。不一会三海龙王就都来到了。
37 东海龙王说去帮助悟空降妖，三海龙王都愿出力。于是，悟空领了四海龙王，不多时，来到号山枯松涧。悟空教他们停在空中，等妖精放火时，一齐喷雨。自己按下云头，到洞前叫战。
page_text_en:
36 Wukong explained his purpose. The Dragon King dared not delay, and immediately struck the drum and bell himself. In no time, the Dragon Kings of the three seas arrived.
37 The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea said he would help Wukong subdue the demon, and the Dragon Kings of the three seas were all willing to lend their strength. Thus, Wukong led the Dragon Kings of the four seas, and soon arrived at Hao Mountain's Ku Song Gorge. Wukong instructed them to hover in the air, ready to spray rain together when the demon unleashed fire. He himself descended to the cave entrance to challenge the demon.
summary_zh: 孙悟空向龙王说明来意，龙王召集三海龙王前来相助；悟空带领四海龙王抵达号山枯松涧，计划在妖精放火时喷雨灭火，并亲自前往洞前挑战。

38 红孩妖闻报，急挺火尖枪，走到洞外，对悟空喝道：
“败将又来找死！”悟空大怒，抡起金箍棒，劈头就打，那
妖精使火尖枪相迎。
39 那妖魔与悟空战有二十回合，见不能取胜，虚晃一
枪，急抽身，又喷出火来。悟空望空高叫道：“快快下雨！”
page_text_en:
38 The demon child, Red Boy, upon hearing the report, hastily brandished his fire-tipped spear, went out of the cave, and shouted at Wukong: 
"You defeated general come to die again!" Wukong, furious, swung his golden cudgel and struck down hard, while the demon wielded his fire-tipped spear to meet him.
39 The demon fought Wukong for twenty rounds, seeing he could not win, feinted with his spear, quickly retreated, and then spat fire again. Wukong looked up and cried out: "Rain, rain, come quickly!"
summary_zh: 红孩儿闻讯出洞与孙悟空再战，二十回合后不敌，佯攻后喷火退走；孙悟空见状，高呼求雨灭火。

40 那四海龙王在半空中现了本相，喷下雨来。原来这雨，只好泼得凡火，如今泼在妖火上面，却好似火上浇油，越泼越大。
41 悟空见火势不息，心中奇怪，便捏着避火诀钻入火中，抡铁棒寻妖。红孩妖见他走近，劈脸喷来一口浓烟。原来悟空不怕火，只怕烟，急回头躲时，已被熏得泪水直淌。
page_text_en:
40 The Four Sea Dragon Kings revealed their true forms in mid-air and began to rain. Originally, this rain could only extinguish ordinary fires, but now poured onto the demon's fire, it was like pouring oil on fire, making it grow even larger.
41 Wukong, seeing the fire still raging, felt puzzled. He then chanted the fire-avoiding spell, plunged into the flames, and swung his iron staff to search for the demon. The Red Boy demon, seeing him approach, spat a mouthful of thick smoke right at his face. Originally, Wukong was not afraid of fire, but afraid of smoke; when he hurriedly turned to dodge, he was already so熏 that tears streamed down his face.
summary_zh: 四海龙王降雨试图扑灭红孩儿的妖火，但火势反而更大；孙悟空进入火中寻妖，被红孩儿喷出的浓烟熏得流泪。

42 那妖又喷一口，悟空受不住，纵上云头走了。红孩儿收了妖火，回转洞府。
43 悟空被妖火烧得浑身难受，便跳入涧中解热，不想被冷水一激，弄得火气攻心，气塞胸膛，倒在水中，顺水漂去。
page_text_en:
42 The demon spat again, and Wukong, unable to bear it, leapt onto the clouds and fled. Honghai'er retracted his demonic fire and returned to his cave.
43 Wukong, tormented by the demon fire, jumped into the stream to cool off, but was shocked by the cold water, causing his internal fire to surge, his chest to become blocked, and he collapsed into the water, drifting away with the current.
summary_zh: 红孩儿喷火逼退孙悟空，孙悟空因被火灼烧跳入涧中解热，却因冷水激导致火气攻心，倒地顺水漂走。

天蓬元帅，卷帘将军，快来救你师兄！
44 四海龙王在空中，见大圣的身躯浮在水上，像死尸一般，向下流冲去，慌忙降下云头从水中捞出大圣，又高声呼唤八戒、沙僧快来。
师兄呀，师兄！……
45 沙僧、八戒听见呼唤声，忙解了马，挑着行李奔出林来。沙僧见悟空这等模样，急得连哭带喊，呼唤悟空。
page_text_en:
Tianpeng Yuan Shuai, Juanlian General, come quickly and save your elder brother!
44 The Four Sea Dragon Kings, seeing the Great Sage's body floating on the water like a corpse, rushing downstream, hurriedly descended from the clouds, pulled him from the water, and loudly called for Bajie and Sha Wujing to come.
Brother! Brother!...
45 Sha Wujing and Bajie, hearing the cries, quickly untied the horse, carried the luggage, and rushed out of the woods. Seeing Wukong in such a state, Sha Wujing cried out in panic, calling for Wukong.
summary_zh: 孙悟空被红孩儿的火攻和冷水激后昏厥，浮在水中，四海龙王将其救起并呼唤八戒、沙僧；沙僧、八戒闻声赶来，见悟空昏迷，急得连哭带喊。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

哥哥呀！你生为师父，死也还在口里叫。快醒醒，我们在这里呢！
师父啊！
46 八戒上前摸一摸行者的胸口，还有一点气，便叫沙僧把悟空上半身扶起，自己在悟空胸口和腹部按摩。不多时，悟空果然醒过来了。
47 悟空睁开眼道：“兄弟们，老孙吃了亏了！”说着站起身，谢过四海龙王。四海龙王见悟空醒来，便驾起云头，各自回龙宫去了。
page_text_en:
Brother! You are our master in life, and even in death, you still call out our names. Wake up quickly, we are here!
Master!
46 Pigsy approached and felt the chest of the pilgrim. There was still a faint breath, so he called Sandy to lift up the upper body of Wukong, while he himself massaged Wukong's chest and abdomen. In no time, Wukong truly woke up.
47 Wukong opened his eyes and said, "Brothers, I've been defeated!" He stood up and thanked the Four Sea Dragon Kings. Seeing Wukong awake, the Four Sea Dragon Kings mounted their clouds and returned to their dragon palaces respectively.
summary_zh: 八戒和沙僧为昏迷的孙悟空进行急救，使其苏醒；悟空醒来后感谢四海龙王，龙王们随即驾云返回龙宫。

48 悟空搭救师父心急，要到南海去请观音菩萨降妖，怎奈浑身无力，驾不起筋斗云。八戒说：‘还是我去吧。’悟空点头答应。八戒驾起云头，向南奔去。
49 再说那红孩妖，回到洞里，心想：猴头吃了亏，一定不会罢休。他走出洞外，跳在空中观看动静，只见八戒驾着云头，往南而去，便料定是去请南海观音。
page_text_en:
48 Wukong, eager to save his master, wanted to go to the South Sea to ask Guanyin Bodhisattva to subdue the demon, but was too weak to ride the somersault cloud. Bajie said, 'Let me go instead.' Wukong nodded in agreement. Bajie mounted the cloud and rushed southward.
49 Meanwhile, the Red Boy demon returned to his cave and thought: 'That monkey has suffered a loss; he certainly won't give up.' He stepped out of the cave, leaped into the air to observe the situation, and saw Bajie riding a cloud heading south. He immediately concluded that Bajie was going to invite Guanyin from the South Sea.
summary_zh: 孙悟空因被火攻和冷水激后昏迷，无力驾云，便让猪八戒前往南海请观音菩萨降妖；红孩儿在洞中得知八戒南行，判断其是去请观音。

50 红孩妖心生一计，急吩咐小妖准备绳索和口袋，在洞门口伺候。自己驾云头，抄近路赶过了八戒，变作观音菩萨模样，坐在山上等候八戒。
51 八戒正纵云行走，忽见菩萨就在面前，他哪里识得真假，急忙倒身下拜，恳求菩萨前去降妖。
page_text_en:
50 The Red Boy demon devised a plan, quickly ordering his minions to prepare ropes and bags, waiting at the cave entrance. He himself rode on a cloud, took a shortcut to overtake Zhu Bajie, transformed into the likeness of the Bodhisattva Guanyin, and sat on the mountain waiting for Zhu Bajie.
51 Zhu Bajie was flying on a cloud when he suddenly saw the Bodhisattva right before him. Not knowing the truth, he hurriedly bowed down and begged the Bodhisattva to go subdue the demon.
summary_zh: 红孩儿化身为观音菩萨，在山中等候前来请援的猪八戒；猪八戒未识破伪装，上前跪拜并恳求菩萨降妖。

52 假菩萨答应去救唐僧，猪八戒满心欢喜，乐呵呵地跟在后面，同往火云洞奔去。
53 不一会儿便到了火云洞。因妖魔早已和小妖们讲了，并无人拦阻，八戒壮着胆子随假菩萨进洞，刚走到二门口，只听得一声呐喊，早埋伏好了的众小妖便把八戒捉住，装在袋内，束紧了口绳，高吊在梁上。
page_text_en:
52 The fake Bodhisattva agreed to rescue Tang Sanzang. Zhu Bajie was overjoyed, happily following behind, rushing together toward Huoyun Cave.
53 Soon they arrived at Huoyun Cave. Since the demon had already told the little demons, no one blocked their way. Bajie, mustering his courage, followed the fake Bodhisattva into the cave. Just as they reached the second gate, a shout rang out, and the hidden little demons immediately seized Bajie, put him in a sack, tied the mouth tightly, and hung him high on the beam.
summary_zh: 猪八戒被化身为观音的红孩儿骗入火云洞，刚进洞便被埋伏的小妖捉住，装入袋中并高吊在梁上。

54 八戒在袋里听得妖王说要用自己下酒，便叫骂不停：
“泼怪物，你们吃了我，管教你们一个个遭肿头瘟！”
55 再说悟空和沙僧正等得心焦，忽然一阵腥风刮过，
悟空道：“不好！这阵风凶多吉少，怕是八戒出了事了！”说着，叫沙僧看守行李、马匹，自己去察看情况。
page_text_en:
54 Pigsy, hearing the demon king say he would use him as a side dish, shouted angrily: 
"You filthy monsters, if you eat me, I'll make you all suffer from swollen-head plague!"
55 Meanwhile, Wukong and Sha僧 were anxiously waiting when suddenly a stinking wind blew by. 
Wukong said: "Oh no! This wind bodes ill, I fear something has happened to Pigsy!" He then told Sha僧 to guard the luggage and horse, and went to investigate.
summary_zh: 猪八戒被红孩儿捉住装入袋中，听到要被当酒菜后破口大骂；孙悟空和沙僧在等候时闻到腥风，悟空判断八戒有难，便让沙僧看守行李，自己前去查看情况。

56 悟空来到火云洞前，见洞门关闭，摇身一变，变成一个小虫儿，从门缝里飞了进去。
57 悟空飞进洞里，只听得八戒在口袋里妖怪长、妖怪短的骂个不休，不由暗笑道：“这呆子虽然在里面受些闷气，却还没有倒了旗枪。我老孙一定要拿了此怪，报仇雪恨。”
好你个妖怪，你假装观音菩萨骗我回来，还要吃我！哼，等我师兄来了，拿住你，我非筑你一千钯不可！
page_text_en:
56 Wukong arrived at the entrance of Huoyun Cave, saw the door closed, transformed himself into a tiny insect, and flew in through the crack.
57 Wukong flew into the cave and heard Baijie cursing inside the sack, calling the demon 'long' and 'short' without stopping. He couldn't help but smile to himself: "This fool is suffering some suffocation inside, but he hasn't given up yet. I, Old Sun, will definitely capture this demon and take revenge!"
You wretched demon! You pretended to be Bodhisattva Guanyin to trick me back, and now you want to eat me! Hmph, when my elder brother arrives, I'll catch you, and I'll surely beat you with a thousand blows from my rake!
summary_zh: 孙悟空变成小虫飞入火云洞，发现猪八戒被装在袋中吊起，正破口大骂红孩儿，孙悟空暗自发誓要捉住妖怪报仇。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

58 悟空正要救八戒出来，忽听得红孩妖吩咐四老妖：云里雾，雾里云，急如火，快如风，去请老大王来吃唐僧肉。悟空听后，顾不得救八戒，“嘤”的一声，跟随四个老妖飞出洞口。
59 四老妖出了洞门，直往西南方向飞奔。悟空心想：他们去请的老大王可能就是牛魔王。待我哄他们一哄，于是将身一摇，变成牛魔王模样，绕路飞到前面去了。
page_text_en:
58 Wukong was about to rescue Bajie when suddenly he heard Honghaiya command the four old demons: 'Through clouds and mist, through mist and clouds, swift as fire, fast as wind, go fetch the Great King to eat the flesh of the monk.' Upon hearing this, Wukong, unable to save Bajie, let out a 'yin' and followed the four old demons out of the cave.
59 The four old demons left the cave entrance and flew straight toward the southwest. Wukong thought: 'The Great King they are fetching might be Niulang. I'll trick them a bit.' So he shook his body, transformed into the likeness of Niulang, and flew ahead by a different route.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在火云洞中发现红孩儿派四老妖去请牛魔王来吃唐僧肉，便放弃救八戒，跟随四老妖飞出洞口，并化身为牛魔王，提前飞到前方准备拦截。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
60 那四老妖正往前走，忽见牛魔王坐在山前，慌得急忙跪倒磕头，说圣婴大王请老大王去吃唐僧肉。假魔王哈哈大笑，连说“好孝顺的儿子。”便随四老妖同去火云洞。
61 红孩妖听说父王来到，便整队迎接。假魔王挺胸脯，迈大步走入火云洞，心中却不住地暗笑。
page_text_en:
60 The four old demons were walking forward when suddenly they saw the Bull Demon King sitting before the mountain. Startled, they hurriedly knelt and bowed, saying that the Holy Infant King had invited the Great King to eat Tang Sanzang's flesh. The fake Demon King laughed heartily, saying, 'What a filial son!' and then followed the four old demons to the Fire Cloud Cave.
61 When the Red Boy heard that his father had arrived, he lined up his troops to welcome him. The fake Demon King puffed out his chest and strode into the Fire Cloud Cave, secretly smiling to himself.
summary_zh: 孙悟空化身为牛魔王，假扮成牛魔王迎接四老妖，四老妖向其行礼，孙悟空随他们前往火云洞；红孩儿得知父亲到来，整队迎接，孙悟空（假魔王）大步走入洞中，心中暗笑。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
62 红孩妖向假魔王行了大礼，说请父王来吃唐僧肉，可以长生不老。假魔王连连摆手道：‘不可！不可！唐僧有个大徒弟名叫孙悟空，十分厉害，我儿不可惹祸。’
63 红孩妖又把摄唐僧、擒八戒、烧悟空的经过说了一遍，叫老魔王不要长人家威风，灭自己锐气。可是这假魔王还是连连称赞悟空厉害，叫他放了唐僧、八戒。
page_text_en:
62 The Red Boy妖 bowed deeply to the fake Demon King, saying, 'Father, come eat the flesh of Tang Sanzang; it will grant you immortality.' The fake Demon King waved his hands repeatedly, saying, 'No! No! Tang Sanzang has a great disciple named Sun Wukong, who is extremely powerful. My son, do not cause trouble.'
63 The Red Boy妖 then recounted the story of capturing Tang Sanzang, seizing Zhu Bajie, and burning Sun Wukong, urging the old Demon King not to boost others' prestige at the expense of his own. However, the fake Demon King still kept praising Sun Wukong's power and told him to release Tang Sanzang and Zhu Bajie.
summary_zh: 红孩儿向假扮牛魔王的孙悟空行礼，邀请其吃唐僧肉以求长生，但假魔王以孙悟空厉害为由拒绝；随后红孩儿讲述捉拿唐僧师徒的经过，假魔王仍称赞孙悟空厉害，并要求释放唐僧和八戒。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
64 红孩儿见老魔王今日的言语行动，不像往常，便到厅外悄悄问快如风等四老妖。四老妖说是从半路上请来的老大王，红孩妖更加怀疑，忽然心生一计，叫众妖准备刀枪，听他指挥。
65 红孩妖转身回到里面，跪下问道：‘孩儿一向想请相士算个命，怎奈把自己的生日忘了，今父王在此，请告诉孩儿一声。’这一问，却把悟空问住了，只得推说年老事繁，一时想不起来。
page_text_en:
64 Honghai'er noticed that the Old Demon King's words and actions today were unlike his usual behavior, so he quietly asked the four old demons, including Kuairufeng, outside the hall. The four old demons said the old king had been invited halfway along the road. Honghai'er became even more suspicious and suddenly devised a plan, ordering the demons to prepare their weapons and follow his command.
65 Honghai'er turned back inside and knelt down, asking: 'Son, I've always wanted to ask a fortune-teller to read my fortune, but I've forgotten my own birthday. Since Father is here now, please tell me, my son.' This question caught Wukong off guard, and he could only excuse himself by saying he was old and busy, and couldn't remember at the moment.
summary_zh: 红孩儿察觉假扮牛魔王的孙悟空行为异常，便私下询问四老妖，随后心生一计，让众妖准备武器。他回到厅内，假装跪下询问父亲生日，以此试探，却让孙悟空一时语塞，无法回答。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
66 红孩妖暗想：‘果然是假的！’就站起来，大喝一声，群妖齐举刀枪，望悟空扑来。悟空现出本相，一边往外冲，一边对红孩妖道：‘我儿，你好没道理，哪有儿子打老子的！’只说得红孩妖满面羞惭。
67 悟空冲出火云洞。红孩妖叫小妖关了洞门，仔细防守。说今日扫兴，准备来日刷洗唐僧蒸吃。
page_text_en:
66 The Red Boy demon thought to himself: 'It's fake after all!' He stood up, roared loudly, and the crowd of demons raised their swords and spears, charging at Wukong. Wukong revealed his true form, rushing out while shouting at the Red Boy: 'Son, you're being unreasonable! How can a son strike his father?' This left the Red Boy demon utterly embarrassed.
67 Wukong burst out of the Fire Cloud Cave. The Red Boy demon ordered the small demons to close the cave entrance and guard it carefully. He complained that today was a failure and planned to prepare Tang Sanzang for steaming and eating tomorrow.
summary_zh: 孙悟空识破红孩儿的试探后现出本相，冲出火云洞，红孩儿恼羞成怒，命令小妖关闭洞门并加强防守，准备日后捉拿唐僧。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
68 再说悟空回到松林里，连连大笑，把刚才的事对沙僧说了一遍。沙僧说：‘师兄不要只图得小便宜，还是搭救师父要紧。’悟空警觉，立即起身去南海请观音菩萨。
69 悟空翻起跟斗云，转眼就飞到南海落伽崖潮音洞，见了菩萨，倒身下拜，把路遇红孩妖的事说了一遍，求菩萨搭救师父。
page_text_en:
68 Then, Wukong returned to the pine forest, laughing heartily, and told Sha僧 everything that had just happened. Sha僧 said, 'Brother, don't just seek small advantages; saving our master is more urgent.' Wukong became alert and immediately set off to the South Sea to ask Guanyin Bodhisattva for help.
69 Wukong flipped up his cloud of somersaults and in an instant flew to the Cao Yin Cave at the foot of the Locha Cliff in the South Sea. He bowed deeply before the Bodhisattva, recounted the encounter with the Red Boy demon, and begged her to rescue his master.
summary_zh: 孙悟空回到松林向沙僧讲述计谋失败，沙僧劝其救师父，悟空随即前往南海请观音菩萨相助。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
70 菩萨听说红孩妖竟敢变做自己模样，兴风作浪，心中恼怒，便捧起座前的宝珠净瓶，又拿了五个金箍，和悟空出洞，驾起云头，离了普陀山，向号山奔去。
71 不一会儿，到了号山火云洞上空，菩萨叫悟空前去挑战。悟空领命，按下云头，来到洞前，高声叫骂，却不见妖怪出来。悟空大怒，举起铁棒，将洞门打了一个大窟窿。
page_text_en:
70 The Bodhisattva, upon hearing that the Red Boy demon had dared to transform into her likeness and stir up trouble, became furious. She picked up the Precious Jewel Pure Vase from her seat, took five golden rings, and, together with Wukong, left the cave, mounted the clouds, departed from Putuo Mountain, and rushed toward Hao Mountain.
71 Soon after, they arrived above the Fire Cloud Cave on Hao Mountain. The Bodhisattva ordered Wukong to go challenge the demon. Wukong obeyed, descended from the clouds, arrived at the cave entrance, shouted loudly, but saw no demon appear. Wukong became furious, raised his iron staff, and smashed a large hole in the cave door.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨得知红孩儿冒充自己后大怒，携带宝物与孙悟空一同前往号山火云洞。孙悟空在洞前挑战未果，愤怒之下用铁棒砸破了洞门。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
72 红孩妖闻报，恨得咬牙切齿，拿起火尖枪，走出洞口，挺枪便刺，悟空举棒相迎。斗了四五合，红孩妖又喷出火来。
73 菩萨在空中见洞前烟火弥漫，急将净瓶倒倾，瓶中的水唿喇喇地倾泻下来，顿时烟消火灭。
page_text_en:
72 The Red Boy demon, upon hearing the report, was furious and gnashed his teeth. He picked up his fire-tipped spear, stepped out of the cave, and lunged forward. Wukong raised his staff to meet him. After fighting for four or five rounds, the Red Boy demon breathed fire again.
73 The Bodhisattva, seeing the smoke and fire spreading before the cave, quickly turned over her pure vase. The water from the vase poured down with a loud gurgle, instantly extinguishing the smoke and flames.
summary_zh: 红孩儿得知孙悟空砸破洞门后愤怒出战，与孙悟空交战并喷火；观音菩萨见洞前火势蔓延，立即倾倒净瓶之水，瞬间扑灭火焰。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
74 红孩妖见破了他的法术，怒火上升，举枪直刺悟空，悟空急忙闪在菩萨背后。
75 红孩妖见一个道婆挡住他的去路，不识高低，怒冲冲举枪就刺。菩萨将手中的杨柳枝一摆，先把红孩妖手里的枪拨落。
page_text_en:
74 The Red Boy demon, seeing his magic broken, became furious and raised his spear to stab Wukong. Wukong quickly dodged behind the Bodhisattva.
75 The Red Boy demon saw an old woman blocking his path, did not recognize her status, and angrily charged forward with his spear. The Bodhisattva waved her willow branch, first knocking the spear out of the Red Boy demon's hand.
summary_zh: 红孩儿因法术被破而愤怒，举枪刺向孙悟空，孙悟空躲到观音菩萨身后；随后红孩儿冲向观音，观音用杨柳枝将他的枪拨落。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
76 菩萨又把五个金箍望红孩妖抛了去，喝声“着”，一个套在他的颈上，两个套在他左右手腕上，两个套在他左右脚腕上。
77 红孩妖呆住了，说道：“这是什么玩意儿？”说着，就要去拾枪。菩萨念起紧箍咒来，痛得那妖精搓耳揉腮，倒在地上乱滚。
page_text_en:
76 The Bodhisattva threw five golden bracelets toward the Red Boy demon, shouting "Zhe!" One landed around his neck, two around his wrists, and two around his ankles.
77 The Red Boy demon froze and said, "What is this thing?" As he reached to pick up his spear, the Bodhisattva chanted the Tightening Spell, causing the demon to writhe in pain, clutching his ears and rubbing his cheeks, rolling on the ground.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨用五个金箍套住红孩儿的颈、手、脚，并念动紧箍咒，使红孩儿疼痛难忍，倒地乱滚。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
78 红孩妖苦苦哀求，说愿意投降。菩萨便松了金箍，从袖中取出一把金剃刀，走至近前把红孩妖分顶剃了几刀，给他留下三个顶搭，挽起三个小辫子来。菩萨又给他起了个名字叫善财童子。
79 悟空见状，拍手笑道：‘我那乖乖，菩萨怕你养不大，给你戴了颈圈金镯，还给你梳小辫子哩！’童子听此话，又生烦恼，拿起枪来，望悟空乱刺。
page_text_en:
78 The Red Child demon pleaded desperately, saying he wished to surrender. The Bodhisattva loosened the golden箍, took out a golden razor from her sleeve, approached him, shaved his head in sections, left three tufts of hair, and tied them into three small braids. She then gave him a new name: Shancai Child.
79 Seeing this, Wukong clapped his hands and laughed: 'My dear little one, the Bodhisattva is afraid you won't grow up properly, so she put a golden neck ring on you and even combed your little braids!' Hearing this, the child became angry again, picked up his spear, and lunged wildly at Wukong.
summary_zh: 红孩儿投降后，观音菩萨为他剃发梳辫并赐名善财童子；孙悟空取笑他，惹得他恼羞成怒，持枪乱刺。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 15: The Fire Cloud Cave'
source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
80 悟空急闪身，躲在菩萨后面，叫道：‘念咒！念咒！’菩萨将杨柳枝儿一摆，叫声‘合！’只见那童子丢了枪，一双手合掌当胸，再也不能开放。这时他才真正降了，朝菩萨连连叩拜。
81 菩萨对悟空道：‘这妖精已降了，却只是野心未驯，待我慢慢教导他。你快救你师父和八戒去吧！’悟空叩头拜谢，菩萨带着善财童子，驾起云头，回南海去了。
page_text_en:
80 Wukong quickly dodged and hid behind the Bodhisattva, shouting, 'Recite the spell! Recite the spell!' The Bodhisattva waved her willow branch and called out, 'Close!' The boy dropped his spear, clasped his hands together over his chest, and could no longer open them. Only then did he truly submit, bowing repeatedly to the Bodhisattva.
81 The Bodhisattva said to Wukong, 'This demon has been subdued, but his wild heart is not yet tamed. I will teach him slowly. Go quickly and rescue your master and Bajie!' Wukong bowed in thanks. The Bodhisattva, carrying the Child of Good Fortune, mounted the clouds and returned to the South Sea.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在观音菩萨的帮助下制服红孩儿，红孩儿投降并被收为善财童子。观音菩萨嘱咐孙悟空去救师父和八戒，随后带着善财童子返回南海。

82 再说沙僧不见悟空回来，心中着急。他把行李拴在降妖宝杖上担在肩头，手牵白龙马，走出松林，见悟空迎面含笑而来。
83 悟空把菩萨降妖之事讲了一遍。沙僧十分欢喜。他俩急急过了涧，打入火云洞，剿尽了群妖，解下口袋，放出了八戒。
哥哥，妖精在哪里？等我去筑他几钯，出一口闷气。
闲话少说，救师父要紧！
page_text_en:
82 Then, Sha Wujing, not seeing Wukong return, grew anxious. He tied the luggage to his demon-subduing staff, slung it over his shoulder, led the White Dragon Horse, and stepped out of the pine forest, where he saw Wukong approaching with a smile.
83 Wukong recounted the story of the Bodhisattva subduing the demon. Sha Wujing was overjoyed. The two hurried across the stream, stormed into the Fire Cloud Cave, exterminated the band of demons, untied the sack, and released Bajie.
Brother, where is the demon? Let me go and strike him a few times with my rake to vent my frustration.
Enough talk, we must save the Master quickly!
summary_zh: 沙僧因等不到孙悟空而焦急，见其归来后，两人一同前往火云洞，击败群妖并救出被俘的猪八戒。

source_file: 连环画《西游记15：火云洞》（6-10岁）.pdf

84 三人来到后院，救了师父。唐僧哭道：‘贤徒啊，叫你们吃苦受累了。’
85 唐僧又问是怎样降了妖魔，悟空便把菩萨收妖之事讲了一遍。唐僧听了，赶紧跪下，朝南望空礼拜。
page_text_en:
84 The three arrived at the back courtyard and rescued their master. Tang Sanzang cried, 'Dear disciples, you've suffered and toiled so much.'
85 Tang Sanzang then asked how the demon was subdued, and Wukong recounted the story of how the Bodhisattva subdued the demon. Upon hearing this, Tang Sanzang hurriedly knelt down and bowed towards the south, looking up into the sky.
summary_zh: 孙悟空、沙僧和猪八戒救出被俘的唐僧，唐僧感激落泪；随后孙悟空向唐僧讲述观音菩萨降伏红孩儿的经过，唐僧听后跪地朝南礼拜。
